best_plan.name: p3
best_plan.rationale: p3 is the best plan because it achieved the highest observed quality (f1_score 1.0), while every cheaper alternative lost accuracy. All good plans used the same cheap exact filter on idx='taken_3' and only differed in the semantic sentiment filter; GPT-4o-MINI was more expensive and slower than Gemini Flash Lite, but it was the only tested option that reliably separated truly positive reviews from mixed or ironic ones.

cost_model_explanation: I fit the cost model from observed operator traces, using per-row cost and latency for filter and sem_filter plus model-specific adjustments. The traces showed exact filter/project/limit were effectively free, while sem_filter dominated both dollars and latency, so plan design focused on minimizing LLM work and choosing the weakest model that still preserved quality. In these runs, Gemini Flash Lite was cheapest, GPT-4.1 Nano was mid-cost, and GPT-4o-MINI was the most expensive among tested models but delivered the best quality.

plan_codes.p1:
pipeline = PhysicalPipeline(plan_name, "Reviews.csv", load_data("Reviews.csv"))
pipeline.filter(lambda row: str(row["idx"]).strip().lower() == "taken_3")
pipeline.sem_filter(
    "the review expresses a positive opinion about the movie overall",
    model=pz.Model.GOOGLE_GEMINI_2_5_FLASH_LITE,
    depends_on=["reviewText"]
)
pipeline.project(["reviewId"])
pipeline.limit(5)
pipeline
